technical.summary: ABBV shows oversold conditions on multiple oscillators but lacks bullish confirmation; price remains below all key moving averages with bearish structure, making this a weak swing entry despite oversold setup.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals with no composite congressional conviction, elevated greed sentiment warranting caution, and insufficient news data to confirm directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (99.3) indicates extreme market stress; earnings in 29 days adds event risk but not imminent.
